line: Six of Wands: Crowley's title, planetary attribution and place on the Tree, with his account of the card.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: Title and planetary attribution, as the chapter gives them (pdf 178, 191).

quotes.quote: The Six of Wands is called Victory.
The reference is also to Jupiter and Leo

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: The Sixes belong to Tiphareth (pdf 177), and the card names it (pdf 191). No further description of the image is quoted for this card.

quotes.quote: These cards are attributed to Tiphareth.
This card represents Tiphareth of the suit of Fire.
